candidates.name: Contact-radical height squeeze (representation axiom + single error integer delta + canonical-height squeeze)
candidates.statement: Every element A of the tested ring is u1/v+u2/v+u3/v with all 13 contact values equal to +-k r for tested elements r; at every contact prime the root coordinates agree with their elliptic indices mod q^K, so M_K(slope)^K divides the one integer delta=f(eta(a)); the five-point estimate then gives h(A)<<B for all A in R; quadratic canonical height of eta(a_j)P forces B=O(1).
